title: Train
body:
Syntax: train <attribute|str|wis|con|int|dex|luk|per|wil|cc>

Description: Spends one training point to raise any of the nine attributes by one, to a maximum of 75. Perception (train per), Willpower (train wil), and Chakra Control (train cc or train chakra control) are all trainable; Willpower now protects against ordinary Genjutsu, Perception extends Scan, and Chakra Control increases maximum Chakra and efficiency. See 'help attributes' for the details.

Date: 2026-08-17
